req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject task creation requests with an empty title by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This behavior ensures data integrity by enforcing mandatory fields. The test suite includes a positive case to verify normal operation, a negative case to test the error pathway, and a boundary case to check the minimum valid input.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid Task", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "description": "A task with empty title", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_minimum_title_length
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of minimum valid length (1 character).
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "A", "description": "A task with minimum title length", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "A"
